q: Which HTML element is used to create a hyperlink?
exp: Use <a href="..."> to create hyperlinks.

q: What does the alt attribute on an provide?
exp: alt provides accessibility text and shows if the image fails to load.

q: Which element should wrap the main navigation links?
exp: Use <nav> for main navigation links.

q: Which tag represents the main content of a document?
exp: <main> contains the primary content unique to that page.

q: Which input type is best for email?
exp: type="email" provides email validation and a better mobile keyboard.

q: Which attribute makes an input mandatory?
exp: The required attribute makes a field mandatory.

q: Which tag is used for an unordered list?
exp: <ul> defines an unordered list.

q: Which tag defines a table row?
exp: <tr> defines a table row.

q: Which element is best for self-contained content like a blog post?
exp: <article> is for independent, reusable content.

q: What does <meta name="viewport"> help with?
exp: Viewport meta tag helps pages scale correctly on mobile.

q: Which property changes text color?
exp: Use color: ... to change text color.

q: What does display:flex do?
exp: display:flex makes children use flex layout.

q: Which unit is relative to the root font size?
exp: rem is based on the root (html) font size.

q: Which property adds spacing outside an element?
exp: margin adds space outside the element.

q: Which property adds spacing inside an element?
exp: padding adds space inside the element.

q: How do you select an element with id='box'?
exp: Use #box to select an element by id.

q: How do you select elements with class='card'?
exp: Use .card to select a class.

q: Which property creates rounded corners?
exp: Use border-radius for rounded corners.

q: Which property controls stacking order?
exp: z-index controls stacking order of positioned elements.

q: In flexbox, which property aligns items on the main axis?
exp: justify-content aligns items along the main axis.

q: In flexbox, which property aligns items on the cross axis?
exp: align-items aligns items along the cross axis.

q: What does box-sizing:border-box do?
exp: border-box includes padding and border within the specified width/height.

q: Which keyword declares a block-scoped variable?
exp: let and const are block-scoped; var is function-scoped.

q: Which operator checks value AND type equality?
exp: === checks strict equality (value + type).

q: Which method converts JSON string to an object?
exp: JSON.parse converts a JSON string to an object.

q: Which method converts an object to JSON string?
exp: JSON.stringify converts an object to a JSON string.

q: Which function runs once after a delay?
exp: setTimeout(fn, ms) runs once after ms.

q: Which function runs repeatedly at intervals?
exp: setInterval(fn, ms) runs repeatedly.

q: How do you select an element by id in JS?
exp: Use document.getElementById('id').

q: What does Array.map() return?
exp: map() returns a new array.

q: Which array method removes the last element?
exp: pop() removes the last element.

q: What does event.preventDefault() do?
exp: It prevents the default browser action (like form submit navigation).

q: Which is correct to add a class to an element?
exp: Use element.classList.add('x').

q: Which loop keyword stops the loop immediately?
exp: break stops a loop.

q: Where should you place a normal <script> for best performance (without defer)?
exp: Place scripts before </body> or use defer.

q: What does HTTP status 404 mean?
exp: 404 means the resource was not found.

q: What is the main purpose of semantic HTML?
exp: Semantic HTML improves structure and accessibility.

q: Which is best for storing small data in the browser?
exp: localStorage stores key/value strings in the browser.

q: Which CSS feature is best for 2D layouts?
exp: CSS Grid is designed for 2D layouts (rows + columns).

q: Which protocol secures HTTP traffic?
exp: HTTPS uses TLS to encrypt HTTP traffic.

q: Which tag is used to embed another HTML page?
exp: <iframe> embeds another document.

q: Which attribute connects a <label> to an <input>?
exp: label's for should match the input's id.

q: Which property makes an element stick while scrolling?
exp: position: sticky sticks after reaching a scroll threshold.

q: Which property sets the thickness of a border?
exp: Use border-width to control thickness.

q: What does const prevent?
exp: const prevents reassignment (objects can still mutate).

q: Which converts a string to a number safely?
exp: Number('10') converts to a number.

q: What does CORS control?
exp: CORS controls cross-origin browser access to resources.

q: Which is a correct REST method to update a resource?
exp: PUT/PATCH are used to update resources.
